name: The Waking
summary: The Shards are stirring and the expeditions are going wrong. Get the party through the gate and see for yourself.

gate.summary: The gate road east of the yard is sealed. Find what opens it.

objectives.text: Pull the relay lever on the gate road
Reach the end of the road

relay.summary: Crew Halden went east to the relay station three days ago and did not come back. Find them.

objectives.text: Reach the relay station east of the road
Find out what happened to Crew Halden

deeper.summary: The log says the singing starts at the second depth. Reach it and come back.

throat.summary: Something is singing under the yard. The Undercity throat has opened south of the plaza road.

objectives.text: Enter the Undercity throat from the yard
Get past whatever holds the throat
Reach the source of the singing

choir.summary: First contact. It knew your name. The demo ends here; the Waking does not.
